title: If India's States Were Countries: Bihar ≈ Mexico, Rajasthan ≈ Germany

beats.say: Take India apart, and twelve of the world's fifty most populous countries would be Indian states.
beats.caption: India split into states: 12 of the world's top 50 by people (2026, projected)

beats.say: Bihar, in eastern India, is projected to have about as many people as Mexico.
beats.caption: Bihar 132.9 M ≈ Mexico 133.0 M (2026, projected)

beats.say: But Mexico has about twenty times the land.
beats.caption: Mexico ≈ 20.7× Bihar's land (Natural Earth measure)

beats.say: Maharashtra, in western India, is projected to outnumber Japan.
beats.caption: Maharashtra 129.6 M vs Japan 122.4 M (2026, projected)

beats.say: In twenty eleven, it was the other way round. Japan has been shrinking.
beats.caption: 1 July 2011: Maharashtra 11.9% behind Japan (NCP vs UN)

beats.say: Rajasthan, in north-west India, has about as many people as Germany.
beats.caption: Rajasthan 83.9 M ≈ Germany 83.6 M (2026, projected)

beats.say: And almost the same amount of land.
beats.caption: Land: 343,697 vs 356,379 km² (Natural Earth measure)

beats.say: Twelve of the world's fifty biggest crowds, inside one country.
beats.caption: 12 of the top 50 · one country (2026, projected)
